T: Too much dynamite. Just enough dinner.
D: Two outlaws flee a relentless posse all the way to Bolivia.
P: Serve the snacks when Butch takes Etta for a ride on the bicycle.
S: Butch and Etta on the bicycle in the morning
Apples, a wedge of sharp cheddar, crusty bread and ham laid out on a picnic cloth.
the gang's new life in Bolivia
Pastry turnovers filled with a juicy stew of beef, potato, peas, cumin and paprika, crimped along the top and baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
the safe they blow with far too much dynamite
Pretzel rods dipped two-thirds in melted red candy melts, a short piece of liquorice strap pushed into the top as a fuse, set on baking paper for 20 minutes.
M: Beef chuck diced and browned, braised with dried chillies, cumin, garlic and tomato for 3 hours. Cornbread.
the long trip south to Bolivia
Chicken thighs browned, onion, garlic, red chilli and tomato cooked down, the chicken simmered in it 25 minutes, served over fluffy quinoa with parsley and lime.
W: the bicycle ride with the song playing
Butter and sugar creamed, eggs and lemon zest beaten in, flour folded through, baked in a loaf tin at 170C for 45 minutes, soaked hot with lemon syrup and topped with thin lemon icing.
K: the saloon before they head for Bolivia
45ml bourbon poured neat into a small glass, a beer chaser for anyone riding with them.

s.note: Butch and Etta on the bicycle in the morning
s.how: Lay a picnic cloth with 3 apples, a 250g wedge of sharp cheddar, a crusty loaf, 200g sliced ham and a dish of butter. Tear and slice as you go, between bicycle rides.

s.note: the safe they blow with far too much dynamite
s.how: Melt 200g red candy melts. Dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way and push a short piece of liquorice strap into the top of each as a fuse. Set on baking paper for 20 minutes.

m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 4 soaked and blitzed dried chillies, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves and a tin of tomatoes. Braise 3 hours. Bake cornbread from 150g cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and egg alongside.

w.note: the bicycle ride with the song playing
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs and lemon zest, and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 45 minutes. Soak with hot lemon syrup, then top with 100g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.

d.note: the saloon before they head for Bolivia
d.how: Pour 45ml bourbon neat into each of four small glasses and set them on the bar. Serve a cold lager alongside as a chaser for anyone riding with the Hole-in-the-Wall gang tonight.
